s.t:
As an Office Manager, you will be responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining a multitude of administrative and management programs supporting the posts of duty (PODs).

These duties include providing overall administrative management to professional and administrative staff, ensuring full support for administrative and litigation programs, managing databases, and supporting automation initiatives.

The Office Manager is also responsible for managing and overseeing subordinate staffs which may be located in multiple PODs.As an Office Manager, you will: Assists in directing all of the administrative/resources management activities necessary for the successful operation of assigned PODs, which may include support of Area Counsel(s), including budget management, personnel management and administration, facilities management, etc.

Identifies and analyzes problems and issues, resource utilization and constraints, and coordination of management controls. Prepares, maintains, and executes the financial plan involving all categories of expenditures.

Develops ad hoc and routine statistical analyses and management status reports, along with recommendations, for the Area Manager and Associate Chief Counsel (FM), for procedural and other changes necessary to adjust the work processes and staffing requirements of the FM POD staff to keep pace with the day-to-day needs of the Office of Chief Counsel.

Reviews, analyzes, makes recommendations, and/or develops contingency plans based on financial, analyses and reports. Identifies trends and anticipates any adverse impact on budget and/or work plans. This is not an all-inclusive list.

The selectee from this vacancy announcement will manage one of the following Cluster Chief Counsel Offices: Portland, OR Sacramento, CA
Who May Apply: Only applicants who meet one of the employment authority categories below are eligible to apply for this job. You will be asked to identify which category or categories you meet, and to provide documents which prove you meet the category or categories you selected.

See "Required Documents" for a list of document requirements for all employment authorities. Career Transition Assistance Program Current Chief Counsel Employee Current IRS Employee In order to qualify, you must meet the education and/or experience requirements described below.

Your resume must clearly describe your relevant experience; if qualifying based on education, your transcripts will be required as part of your application.

To qualify for this position of Office Manager you must meet the qualification requirements listed below by the closing of this announcement: For GS-11: Specialized Experience: Your resume must detail at least one year of specialized experience which includes:- Gathering data to estimate resource requirements- Prepare in-depth report to track progress of current goals- Procure office resources to include contractor support services and office suppliesThis definition of specialized experience is typical of work performed at the next lower grade/level position in the federal service (GS-09).

OR Education Substitution: You may substitute education for specialized experience as follows: Ph.D. or equivalent doctoral degree OR three full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to such a degree OR LL.M., if related.

OR Combination of Education and Experience: You may qualify by a combination of experience and education: Options for qualifying based on a combination are identified in the online questions. NOTE: If qualifying based on education, your transcripts will be required as part of your application package.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community; student; social). You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

One year of experience refers to full-time work; part-time work is considered on a prorated basis. To ensure full credit for your work experience, please indicate dates of employment by month/year, and indicate number of hours worked per week, on your resume.

Time in Grade Requirement for GS-11: Applicants who have held a General Schedule (GS) position within the last 52 weeks must have 52 weeks of Federal service at the next lower grade or equivalent (GS-09).

s.h: BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER
s.t:
At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.
Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you .
We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you.

At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.
This includes using AI to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. Such screening may amount to a form of solely automated decision-making. We also use AI for administrative support, like scheduling and recording interviews and summarizing interview notes. Our recruiting teams remain responsible for all hiring decisions and are involved throughout the process.

Position Overview: At Ready Roles, we don’t just fill positions; we build lasting, impactful careers. As a Remote Executive Assistant, you will step into a critical role as a trusted “right arm” for an American business owner, making an essential difference in their day-to-day and long-term success.

We are looking for driven, proactive individuals who don’t wait for instructions but actively seek opportunities to make an impact. This role is for self-starters who thrive on finding solutions, tackling new challenges, and staying one step ahead of the business owner’s needs.

Ready Roles carefully vets every client to ensure a respectful, growth-oriented work environment where your contributions are valued. We’re looking for someone ready to build a future, grow their skills, and commit to long-term success with their client. Why Join Ready Roles?

A Career Path, Not Just a Job: This isn’t a stepping-stone; it’s a role designed for long-term growth. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to build a stable career with a supportive company that invests in their future.

Independence and Opportunity to Lead: Our clients want self-driven assistants who identify opportunities for improvement, find ways to make the business run smoothly, and drive the organization forward without needing to be told what to do. You’ll actively manage the business owner’s schedule and push organizational goals, not just your own tasks.

Respectful, Growth-Focused Clients: We only partner with clients who value stability and respect for their team. As a Ready Role, you’ll work with a business owner who is committed to your success and who shares a long-term vision for growth. Key Responsibilities: 1.

Daily Management and Proactive Support: Calendar and Schedule Management: Oversee and prioritize the CEO’s calendar, blocking time for high-priority tasks, scheduling meetings, and ensuring the CEO is fully prepared for each day.

Email and Communication Oversight: Sort, prioritize, and respond to emails and messages, filtering essential information to keep the CEO focused and eliminating routine communication distractions.

Daily Check-Ins and Task Planning: Conduct a daily check-in with the CEO to review priorities, set action items, and address any immediate needs, keeping both the CEO and the team on track. 2.

Self-Directed Task Identification: Identify Areas to Add Value: Proactively seek out tasks or projects that align with business goals, whether improving internal processes, coordinating with team members, or streamlining workflows.

Manage and Anticipate Owner’s Needs: Track ongoing projects, follow up on open items, and keep the CEO informed on key updates and deadlines without needing reminders ￼. 3. Invoicing & Accounts Support
Send out invoices promptly and accurately
Monitor invoice status and ensure payments are received
Follow up on unpaid invoices (e.g., after 1 week)
Maintain detailed and organized invoicing records with clear notes (e.g., date sent, follow-ups required)
Assist with tracking company expenses and maintaining financial spreadsheets
What We’re Looking For: Self-Driven, Proactive Mindset - This role is for someone who naturally takes the initiative and actively finds ways to contribute. You’ll be expected to add value without waiting for instructions and to be a driving force for the business. Commitment to Long-Term Growth - Ready Roles is built on loyalty and stability.

We’re looking for someone who values a long-term commitment, seeks stability, and is motivated to build a future with us and the business owner they support. Aligned with Our Values - Ready Roles believes in accountability, respect, and integrity.

We’re looking for someone who takes ownership of their work, consistently shows up with purpose, and is eager to create a lasting impact.

Qualifications: Must be based in the Philippines Must have basic accounting (invoicing) knowledge and experience Must know how to utilize QuickBooks 18 years old and above Willing to work from home with a stable internet connection Must have own equipment — reliable laptop or PC and a noise-cancelling headset Available to work full-time (40 hours per week) Leadership Potential and Vision: Prior experience managing remote tasks or supporting a business owner is a plus, but we’re most interested in candidates ready to take ownership, lead by example, and actively shape the future of their role.

Resourceful and Solution-Oriented: You’ll look for ways to make the business owner’s day-to-day run smoothly, identifying gaps, solving problems, and proactively contributing to long-term growth.

Strong Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills to maintain consistent, professional interactions with the business owner, team members, and clients. Growth-Minded and Self-Motivated: If you’re looking for a career where you can make an impact and build something lasting, Ready Roles is the place for you.

This role is designed for someone who sees this as more than just a job—a chance to lead, grow, and secure their future. Apply Today If you’re ready to commit, lead, and build a career with purpose, stability, and growth, we’d love to hear from you.

About the opportunity
We have an exciting opportunity to join the N26 Executive Office as Executive Assistant to our Chief Technology Officer (CTO) .
At N26, our team of Executive Assistants provide high-level management support, clerical and business assistance, plus direction and guidance to support in the achievement of strategic priorities and business goals and objectives. This opportunity will allow you to see what the daily life of a C-Level executive is like, how N26 is managed, and how our senior management works together.
The Executive Assistant is responsible for providing sophisticated administrative and operational support while contributing to projects that help drive business priorities and strengthen team collaboration in a way that facilitates the executive and teams being their most productive and effective.
Taking direction from the Chief of Staff of the N26 Executive Office, the Executive Assistant is ultimately responsible for ensuring seamless back office and logistical support.

Assist in managing competing executive time, focus, and priorities in line with strategic objectives and short-term goals and objectives, assessing any shift in priorities as appropriate through the following:
Manage complex calendars, across multiple time zones including vetting, prioritising, and providing recommendations on meeting cadence, time spent, and optimising scheduling on an ongoing basis.
Act as a gatekeeper for the CTO, by reviewing incoming requests and assessing the purpose, objective, and desired outcomes of requests. You will review communications to the CTO and handle, reassign or prioritize these for the executive in line with identified and understood priorities and areas of responsibility with the team and business.
Assess and manage the flow of information, communications, and access to the CTO.
Use your judgment to prevent unnecessary involvement of the CTO in day-to-day office management issues, team issues and daily interruptions. The Executive Assistant will manage enquiries unilaterally where possible, or bring them to the attention of the Chief of Staff, where necessary.
Draft communications, documents, and presentations.
Manage and/or oversee projects as directed, including the development of plans for such projects. This includes following up and providing reminders on project deadlines, action items, and deliverables.
Assist and/or manage all logistics from end-to-end of small to large scale events planning, including team meetings, all-hands and offsites.
Prepare complex and highly detailed national and international travel itineraries at a very short notice; including, but not limited to, purchase of flight tickets, accommodation, ground transportation, visa requirements and applicable security measures.
Ensure all logistical and administrative duties are completed in a timely manner, including expense reports, reimbursement requests, post management, IT support, and financial administration.

s.h: As well as have the following responsibilities
s.t:
Build and maintain strong relationships with all team members, direct reports, internal executives and stakeholders in other divisions or departments, as well as any relevant external clients or partners.
Partner with other Executive Assistants in the N26 Executive Office and key stakeholders on driving efficiency and improved processes for the Management Team of N26, and support or step-in when needed to ensure business continuity.
Support initiatives of the CTO, or elsewhere in the organization, as required and act as an advocate of the CTO.
Report into the N26 Executive Office and be an integral team member to all executive support staff at N26.

At least five years of relevant work experience as an Executive Assistant supporting senior executives or leaders in dynamic and fast-paced environments.
Previous project management experience would be beneficial.
Fluent in business-level English.

Excellent communicator, rapport and relationship builder, with very high emotional intelligence and the ability to maintain key relationships.
Highly competent at managing workflow, priorities, diaries and schedules for multiple persons, including yourself and the executive.
Level of integrity that is beyond reproach and be able to keep confidences and corporate confidentiality without question, as well as professionalism with senior leaders.
Must be good at assessing and analyzing vast quantities of data, information and communications and assessing the relevance of these and their level of priority at all times.
Adept at quickly learning and understanding the roles and responsibilities of the CTO and his team and others within the organization who support the N26 Executive Leadership Team.
Possess advanced office software skills; strong written communication skills, including the drafting and editing of high-level documents; advanced presentation preparation and design skills; a strong financial numeracy and corporate finance understanding is a plus.
Rational thinker with problem-solving capabilities and the ability to complete complex tasks and projects quickly with little to no guidance.
Adept at dealing with a variety of complex stakeholders and difficult situations and at managing and overcoming conflict.
You react with appropriate urgency to situations that require a quick turnaround and take effective action to continually improve the status quo.

Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.
Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.
As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.
Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences and family statuses.
A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

This position is in the Supreme Court of the United States, Police Force Administrative Services Unit. The Executive Assistant for the Police Force reports to and receives general direction and supervision from the Administrative Services Unit, Administrative Officer.

However, the individual will directly support the Chief of Police, Deputy Chief of Police, and other Police Leadership staff as designated by the Chief of Police or their designee. The incumbent regularly works with Police leadership to draft written materials and perform a variety of special and complex assignments on behalf of the Chief of Police.

The Executive Assistant's core responsibilities include assisting the Police Executive Team (e.g., Chief of Police, Deputy Chief of Police, and Captains) with compiling reports, responding to inquiries, reconciling and tracking information, and drafting and managing correspondence.

Other major duties include: project management, budget tracking and contracting responsibilities; managing office administration including calendars, schedules, meetings, and travel; research on specialized topics; assisting with other program areas within the department; and providing back-up support with clearance requests, badging and fingerprinting.

At times, the incumbent may be responsible for driving executives, documents, supplies, or equipment to and from events. The incumbent may perform other duties as assigned.
A minimum of four years of office experience is required. Experience working successfully under pressure in a busy office is preferred. Outstanding attention to detail, strong organizational skills, tact, and a courteous demeanor are required. Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Word is required.

Experience working in a police force, security, or judicial environment is preferable, but not required. Valid driver's license is required. Knowledge and Skills: Strong organizational, communication, and administrative skills, along with proficiency in office software, and the ability to handle complex information.

Key knowledge areas include departmental policies and procedures, federal contract management, booking travel, and records management. Crucial skills involve multitasking, independent judgment, maintaining confidentiality and positive interpersonal interactions with diverse individuals.

Considerable skill in: Following complex and varied oral and written instructions. Establishing and maintaining effective work relationships with associates and the public. Operation of office and computer equipment, including working knowledge of databases, spreadsheets, and word processing software.

Understanding and interpreting policies, directions, and procedures applicable to the Supreme Court, Marshal's Office, and Police Force. Must be able and willing to drive a motor vehicle with passengers to work events.

We’re looking for an experienced, full-time Executive Assistant to join our team in Berlin and support our Co-CEOs, Lennard and Judith.
In this role, you’ll work closely with our Co-CEOs, Lennard and Judith, as part of a young, entrepreneurial team. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, love bringing order to hectic schedules, and approach each day with a proactive mindset, we’d love to meet you.
We’re looking for someone highly organized, calm, self-motivated, and adaptable.

Internal organisation and steering. You run the CEO's operating rhythm. Calendar, inbox triage, meeting preparation, and follow-through all sit with you. You keep an eye on details and you keep the leadership cadence (weeklies, board preparation, offsites) moving.
External travel and speaking. You plan and book complex international travel end to end, and you manage the speaking pipeline: inbound requests, selection, briefing packs, and logistics on the ground.
C-level relationship management. You become the trusted point of contact for the CEO's most important external relationships: customers, partners, and investors. You track who needs a touchpoint and when, and protect these relationships through reliability and proactivity.
Augmentation and anticipation. You work half a step ahead of everyone else in the room. You can identify a bottleneck before it forms. You build the systems, defaults and briefings that let the CEO spend their time on judgement rather than logistics.
Admin. You manage expenses and finance admin and can support with occasional personal assistant (PA) duties as needed.
CEO office collaboration. You’ll work in very close coordination with the CEO office, which includes a Chief of Staff and CEO Office Manager who are responsible for operational processes in the CEO office. Incl. performance management, KPI tracking, leadership accountability and strategic projects.
You Might Be a Fit If…
You have previously supported a CEO or equivalent in a demanding organisation and are looking for another environment that gives you an opportunity to grow.
You want to be in a young, fast company. You are comfortable with ambiguity, short timelines and a team that is still writing its own playbook, and you would rather shape the system than inherit a finished one.
You are mission-driven. You care that European companies build and adopt AI, and you want your work to count toward that rather than toward a job title. You are eager to automate your own work where possible.
AI can do a lot of things, but in the short term, it won't be able to shepherd a growing group of mostly young people in a very dynamic environment. We are looking for someone who can foster the most important human qualities within the organization.
We are looking for a long-term partner, not someone optimizing for their next role.
Personified calmness – You bring order, not chaos. When things get hectic, you're the person who slows down, thinks clearly, and helps others do the same. Your presence makes people feel like things are under control. You instill calmness and continuity in the organization.
Good judgment – You know what matters and what doesn't. You read people well. You understand when to push and when to give space, when something is urgent and when it can wait.
Compassionate and empathetic – You care about the people around you. You understand that behind every missed deadline or dropped ball is a human with hidden context. You hold people accountable with kindness.
Ownership mentality – You see problems and fix them without being asked. You don't wait for permission. You follow through.
Strong communicator – Written and verbal. You can draft important emails or have a difficult conversation with equal skill.
Trustworthy – You'll have access to everything and work directly with the CEO. Discretion and trust are very important.
You are a kind person who cares about the people around you.
The Environment
We work from our office in Berlin, Greifswalder Strasse 212. Everyone works together in person because the hardest problems get solved faster at a whiteboard than in a Slack thread. Conversations happen faster, problems get solved quicker, and we actually know each other.
Days start at 8:30. Lunch & dinner are together. We run, go to the gym, and take care of ourselves. Health is not separate from work here, it is part of how we work well.
The vibe is calm but intense. No one is yelling or panicking. But everyone is working hard on things that matter.

We will figure out the right level together based on your experience and scope. Levels are about the work you own, not your title or years of experience. We narrow down the expected salary range early in the process.
Next steps
We move fast. Most processes complete within two weeks.

## Description du poste ##
En qualité de coordinateur ou coordinatrice gestion des locaux, vous assurez la coordination des demandes liées à l'attribution des locaux, aux aménagements des espaces de travail ainsi qu'aux déménagements des activités et des collaborateurs et collaboratrices au sein des HUG.
Interlocuteur ou interlocutrice privilégiée du personnel, vous analysez les besoins exprimés et veillez à leur cohérence avec la stratégie immobilière institutionnelle ainsi qu'avec le schéma directeur des HUG.
Vous évaluez les demandes, proposez des solutions adaptées et recherchez des alternatives permettant une utilisation efficiente des surfaces et des ressources mises à disposition.
Vous pilotez de manière autonome les mandats d'aménagement et de déménagement de faible à moyenne complexité, depuis leur planification jusqu'à leur réalisation. À ce titre, vous coordonnez les différents intervenants et intervenantes internes et externes, assurez le suivi des prestataires et veillez au respect des délais, des coûts et des exigences réglementaires.
Vous participez activement à l'accompagnement du changement auprès des équipes concernées par les mouvements d'activités ou les réorganisations d'espaces.
Vous assurez également la gestion et la mise à jour de la signalétique de proximité en collaboration avec la Direction de la communication, tout en veillant au respect de la charte graphique institutionnelle.

Vous possédez des connaissances des normes et réglementations applicables aux espaces de travail, notamment en matière d'ergonomie, de sécurité et d'aménagement des locaux.
Vous maîtrisez les outils bureautiques usuels. Une expérience sur des logiciels de dessin ou de gestion des espaces constitue un atout.
Vous avez un excellent sens du service, vous faites preuve d'autonomie, de rigueur et d'organisation dans la conduite de vos activités.
Votre aisance relationnelle, votre capacité à coordonner et votre aptitude à accompagner le changement vous permettent d'évoluer efficacement dans un environnement hospitalier en constante évolution.
Vous avez d-excellentes capacités d'analyse, êtes pragmatique et proposez des solutions adaptées aux besoins du personnel tout en tenant compte des contraintes institutionnelles.

This is a dual-mandate role within Takeda-s Data, Digital & Technology (DD&T) organization, based in Zurich, Switzerland. Reporting into the Enterprise Process Platforms organization, the successful candidate will serve in two complementary capacities:
* **Executive Assistant to the Head of Enterprise Process Platforms -** providing dedicated, high-quality executive administrative support to the leader of the organization, with full administrative accountability for that leader.
* **DD&T Site Lead for Zurich -** serving as the local DD&T Leadership Team (LT) site support resource when DD&T LT members travel to Zurich, ensuring a consistent, professional, and executive-ready onsite experience.
The Zurich Site Lead responsibility focuses on site-specific logistics and local coordination for DD&T LT activity in Zurich; it does not include assuming administrative ownership for other LT members. This role is based in Zurich.

Executive Assistant to the Head of Enterprise Process Platforms
Provide dedicated executive administrative support to the Head of Enterprise Process Platforms, operating with the discretion, judgment, and executive presence required to support a senior DD&T leader and to interact effectively with Takeda Executive Team (TET) members.
* **Calendar and schedule management:** Proactively own and manage a complex, frequently changing executive calendar - prioritizing commitments, resolving conflicts, and protecting time against competing demands.
* **Meeting coordination and agenda preparation:** Coordinate meetings end-to-end, prepare and circulate agendas, coordinate pre-reads, and ensure the leader is fully prepared.
* **Meeting facilitation:** Where appropriate, facilitate or lead meetings on behalf of the leader.

* **Stakeholder management:** Build and maintain strong working relationships across DD&T, the broader enterprise, and external partners, acting as a trusted point of contact for the leader-s office.
* **Travel and event logistics:** Organize complex domestic and international travel and associated logistics - including multi-party alignment across internal groups and, at times, external or industry partners - and partner with central meeting planning teams on larger trips, meetings, and events.

* **Documents, presentations, and data:** Where appropriate, prepare and coordinate documents, correspondence, reports, and presentations; collect, review, enter, and format accurate data using Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint; and ensure materials adhere to corporate and organizational standards.

* **Proactivity and problem solving:** Anticipate the leader-s needs, identify issues early, and resolve problems proactively before they escalate.
* **Continuous improvement and network:** Participate in process improvement and build a strong internal network to answer questions, solve problems, and execute responsibilities effectively.

This is a dual-mandate role within Takeda’s Data, Digital & Technology (DD&T) organization, based in Zurich, Switzerland. Reporting into the Enterprise Process Platforms organization, the successful candidate will serve in two complementary capacities:
Executive Assistant to the Head of Enterprise Process Platforms — providing dedicated, high-quality executive administrative support to the leader of the organization, with full administrative accountability for that leader.
DD&T Site Lead for Zurich — serving as the local DD&T Leadership Team (LT) site support resource when DD&T LT members travel to Zurich, ensuring a consistent, professional, and executive-ready onsite experience.
The Zurich Site Lead responsibility focuses on site-specific logistics and local coordination for DD&T LT activity in Zurich; it does not include assuming administrative ownership for other LT members. This role is based in Zurich.

Executive Assistant to the Head of Enterprise Process Platforms
Provide dedicated executive administrative support to the Head of Enterprise Process Platforms, operating with the discretion, judgment, and executive presence required to support a senior DD&T leader and to interact effectively with Takeda Executive Team (TET) members.
Calendar and schedule management: Proactively own and manage a complex, frequently changing executive calendar – prioritizing commitments, resolving conflicts, and protecting time against competing demands.
Meeting coordination and agenda preparation: Coordinate meetings end-to-end, prepare and circulate agendas, coordinate pre-reads, and ensure the leader is fully prepared.
Meeting facilitation: Where appropriate, facilitate or lead meetings on behalf of the leader.
Executive communications: Draft, review, and coordinate executive-level communications, and communicate clearly and professionally with TET members, senior leaders, and their assistants on behalf of the leader.
Stakeholder management: Build and maintain strong working relationships across DD&T, the broader enterprise, and external partners, acting as a trusted point of contact for the leader’s office.
Travel and event logistics: Organize complex domestic and international travel and associated logistics – including multi-party alignment across internal groups and, at times, external or industry partners – and partner with central meeting planning teams on larger trips, meetings, and events.
Expenses coordination: Work with DD&T central expense management role to ensure appropriate submission and completion of leader expenses
Documents, presentations, and data: Where appropriate, prepare and coordinate documents, correspondence, reports, and presentations; collect, review, enter, and format accurate data using Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint; and ensure materials adhere to corporate and organizational standards.
Vendor and payment support: Prepare documentation for payment of vendors, consultants, and suppliers; submit and track payment requests and purchase orders and respond to related inquiries.
Confidentiality, judgment and discretion: Handle highly confidential and sensitive information with the utmost discretion at all times and exercise strong, independent judgment – including the confidence to respectfully challenge or decline a request from a senior leader or TET member when it is in the best interest of the leader’s priorities.
Proactivity and problem solving: Anticipate the leader’s needs, identify issues early, and resolve problems proactively before they escalate.
Continuous improvement and network: Participate in process improvement and build a strong internal network to answer questions, solve problems, and execute responsibilities effectively.
Junior and team administrative support: Provide guidance and support to junior administrative staff, enhancing team capabilities, and aid the broader administrative team as needed to ensure seamless DD&T senior leader support

s.h: Perform other related duties as required.
s.t:
DD&T Zurich Site Lead (Local Hub Support)
Serve as the local DD&T site support resource and point of contact when DD&T Leadership Team (LT) members travel to Zurich. This responsibility is focused on site-specific logistics and local coordination – creating a consistent, high-quality experience for visiting DD&T LT members.
A. Site Logistics and Meeting Room Coordination
Identify and book appropriate rooms for DD&T LT meetings based on attendee size, confidentiality, meeting type, executive experience, and technology requirements.
Confirm room suitability – seating capacity, executive readiness, configuration, hybrid meeting capability, and proximity to relevant office areas.
Coordinate with local workplace, facilities, reception, security, ETSS, CTSS, and AV teams as needed.
Support onsite readiness before meetings begin – room access, setup, supplies, and escalation of facilities or technology issues.
Serve as the local point of contact for site-specific logistical questions related to DD&T LT visits.
B. Catering and Hospitality Support
Arrange catering for DD&T LT meetings, including working lunches, refreshments, and coffee service.
Confirm dietary requirements, timing, delivery location, setup, and cleanup expectations.
Coordinate with approved onsite catering providers and local site teams.
Ensure catering plans align with the agenda, meeting flow, and executive-level expectations.
Escalate issues promptly when catering, hospitality, or room readiness may impact the attendee experience.
C. Local Reservations and Offsite Needs
Make restaurant reservations for DD&T LT dinners, small executive gatherings, and business meals connected to DD&T LT travel.
Recommend appropriate local venues based on audience, purpose, location, accessibility, timing, and executive expectations.
Coordinate reservation details, timing, attendee count, and dietary considerations with venues.
Support approved offsite reservations connected to DD&T LT activities, keeping the primary scope on onsite hub support.
Provide local guidance on practical needs – site navigation, arrival logistics, and visitor access.
D. DD&T LT Meeting and Event Support
Partner with central meeting planning teams on local execution details for larger DD&T LT meetings, offsites, and leadership sessions held in Zurich.
Support local arrangements – room layouts, furniture setup, catering coordination, visitor access, signage, AV needs, and site readiness.
Provide practical site knowledge to central meeting planning teams, including room recommendations, local constraints, vendor considerations, and escalation contacts.

For more than three decades, KPMB Architects has evolved in response to a changing world and worked to change it for the better. Guided by our purpose and anchored by our values, KPMB crafts design solutions that catalyze positive change.

s.h: The role / What are we looking for?
s.t:
KPMB is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Junior Executive Assistant professional to join our team. This administrative role is integral in ensuring that our executive team operates efficiently and effectively by providing comprehensive administrative support. You will be responsible in handling various tasks to ensure our executives can focus on their core responsibilities. The role demands a proactive, self-motivated individual who demonstrates initiative.

You will work closely with our Senior Executive Assistant to manage schedules, coordinate meetings, and ensure all administrative tasks are handled promptly and accurately. Ultimately, you will contribute to the smooth operation of our executive functions, keeping the team informed and on track with their deliverables and priorities.

Manage daily calendars for the Partners, scheduling meetings, conferences, events, appointments, and travel arrangements.
Work closely with the Executive administration team to maintain comprehensive and accurate records, including document management and filing systems.
Manage timesheets, expenses, and invoices for the Partners, including creating expense reports and submitting invoices for payment.

Prepare and edit correspondence, communications, presentations, and other documents.
Handle incoming and outgoing correspondence including emails and phone calls, ensuring timely responses and follow-ups.
Assist in the preparation of reports, meeting agendas, and minutes.
Office license management (Partner’s licenses in various provinces and states, registration, licensing renewal, etc.)
Front desk coverage when Receptionist is away.

Take detailed minutes during internal and external meetings, ensuring all action items are clearly documented and distributed to relevant personnel.
Coordinate and communicate with various departments, stakeholders, and external partners to facilitate smooth operations.

Update meeting agendas and take detailed minutes for Business Development and Marketing meetings.
Schedule content development meetings, calls, and calendar coordination for team members and external collaborators.
Ensure corporate memberships for various associations are current, including registrations and renewals.
Administrative coordination for sponsorships and marketing activations: digital filing for contracts, reports, invoices, etc.
Handle conference and event registration and RSVPs for Leadership.
Manage travel arrangements for conferences, meetings, and events for partners and team members.
Lead coordination of marketing events, including liaising with third-party vendors.
Assist in preparation and distribution for marketing collateral (technical prep, mailings).
Coordinate logistics for internal and external meeting (venue booking, catering, AV, guest lists).
Serve as point of contact between Marketing/Business Development team and other business functions.
Maintain CRM database to ensure up-to-date, accurate, and legible experience.
Pull reports from marketing software.

A minimum of 1 year of experience in a similar administrative or assistant role.
Ability to multitask, managing a high volume of work and competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Proficiency with MS Office Suite.
Outstanding organizational, schedule coordination, and administrative skills.
Ability to work well in a collaborative team environment.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Praised to have problem solving and critical thinking skills.
A self-starter who demonstrates initiative.

Founded in 1987, KPMB Architects has developed a diverse portfolio of architectural projects that focus on building healthy, vibrant cities and communities. The firm has grown to include over 100 employees and is recognized for its highly collaborative and supportive culture, as well as its wide variety of experience and educational backgrounds.

Some of our team members have grown with the firm from the start of their careers to become leaders, while others have joined at various points in their careers, bringing new ideas and approaches.

We provide a learning environment where teaching, mentoring, and collaboration are integral parts of our DNA. At KPMB, there are numerous opportunities to share your skills, engage in firm activities beyond project work, and contribute to our initiatives that give back to the community.

KPMB is committed to fostering a workforce that reflects the diversity of the communities we operate in and serve. KPMB Architects is an Equal Opportunity Employer that considers applicants regardless of age, race, colour, national origin, citizenship, religion, creed, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other protected status.

A daily free shuttle bus between Union Station and KPMB’s office is provided for all staff who use the subway system or GO transit, from Monday to Thursday. Underground bicycle parking is also available.

As part of our recruitment process, we may use AI tools to support application screening. All applications are ultimately reviewed and assessed by qualified members of our recruitment team.

Executive Assistant - Chicago

We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Executive Assistant to support our partnership team. The ideal candidate will be resourceful, detail-oriented, mission focused, and capable of handling a wide range of administrative and executive support tasks.

The chosen candidate will have at least six years of full-time, onsite experience in a professional office setting with a proven record of success in all areas required of the role. This position is a member of the Administrative Team, which includes HR, Operations, and Office Managers. The position reports to the Director of HR but works directly for the partner.

This position is full-time and based onsite in our Chicago office in the West Loop area. Benefits can be found listed on our careers page.

These responsibilities reflect the dynamic role of an Executive Assistant, where flexibility, organization, and proactive support are essential to the business's success and efficiency.

Administrative Support

Manage partners' calendars and schedules, including arranging appointments and meetings.
Handle incoming and outgoing correspondence, including emails, letters, and calls.
Prepare reports and presentations for meetings and presentations.
Support partners with quarterly goals and other small projects as requested.
Ensure completion of all tasks with high focus on prompt follow-through.
Anticipate partners' needs and proactively handle administrative tasks.
Conduct research and compile data for executive decision-making.
Handle personal tasks and errands as requested.

Communication Liaison

Handle requests and queries appropriately.
Act as a liaison between partners, teams, clients, vendors, and external stakeholders.
Coordinate client meetings and events, ensuring a smooth experience.
Ability to acknowledge the sensitivity and maintain privacy of internal partner and leadership coordination.
Ensure partner and leadership dialog in sensitive matters held in confidence.

Travel and Accommodation Arrangements

Arrange travel itineraries, including flights, accommodations, and ground transportation.
Prepare travel agendas (often with input from other team members), necessary documents, and expense reports.
Share the partners’ travel agendas with other team members for coordination.
Ensure travel plans align with partners' schedules and preferences.

Data Management and Record Keeping

Maintain accurate records and files, both electronic and physical.
Ensure information confidentiality and data protection.

Share opportunities to streamline processes and improve efficiency.
Implement best practices in administrative support.
Stay updated on industry trends and administrative tools to enhance job performance.

Proven experience as an executive or administrative assistant or similar administrative role.
Excellent MS Office knowledge and proficiency and Abobe Suite, specifics experience with InDesign and PowerPoint.
Outstanding organizational and time management skills.
Ability to multitask and prioritize daily workload.
Discretion and confidentiality.
Knowledge of EOS and the supporting platform (Bloomgrowth) is a plus but not required.
Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
A proactive approach to problem-solving with strong decision-making skills.
Bachelor’s degree in business administration or relevant experience.
Experience in a business environment.
Expertise in project management tools and software.
Experience managing and coordinating requests from multiple staff.

Work Environment: Monday through Friday 8:30-5:30 with an hour for lunch/breaks.
Benefits: Health benefits, paid time off, 401(k), to/from office commute paid, or parking provided, and opportunities for career growth within a dynamic and expanding company.

Salary: Range is $70,000-$85,000; the offer will be based on experience, skills and background in similar positions.

Als Store Manager / Assistant für L-Oréal Luxe stehst du für Eleganz und Raffinesse und inspirierst dein Team von Beauty Advisors, die -kraftvolle, sinnliche und spektakulär einfache- Philosophie der Marke zum Ausdruck zu bringen. Als Store Manager / Assitant hast du folgende Aufgaben:
* **Beherrschung grundlegender Produkt- und Markenkenntnisse:** Dein Fachwissen in Form von Kenntnissen der einzelnen Produkte sowie auch ihrer Anwendung und dein umfassendes Verständnis der Erwartungen an die Marke ermöglichen es dir, exzellenten Kundenservice zu bieten. Du kennst die neuesten Markttrends, insbesondere im Bereich Beauty-Tech.
* **Du leitest dein Team mit inspirierender Führung, um das Geschäft deines Counters voranzutreiben und alle Ziele zu erreichen:** Du misst dch an den Retail-KPIs, indem du der Entwicklung des Marktes und des Wettbewerbs folgst. Du identifizierst Geschäftsmöglichkeiten für die Verkaufsstelle und koordinierst mit dem Retail- und Trainings-Team die umzusetzenden Massnahmen, um den Umsatz weiter zu steigern. Du trägst mit gezielten Aktionen und CRM zur erweiternden Pflege der Kundendatenbank bei.
* **Kultivieren von Service-Exzellenz:** Du überträgst deine Leidenschaft und verkörperst die Werte der Marke, indem du die Attraktivität deines Counters sicherstellst, um unseren Kund\*innen einen exzellenten Service zu bieten. Du pflegst eine Omnichannel-Service-Einstellung, die eine konstante Servicequalität sowohl offline als auch online gewährleistet.
** **
** **

Idealerweise zeigst du eine Leidenschaft für die Welt der Schönheit und legst Wert auf einen aussergewöhnlichen Kundenservice. Das bringst du mit:
** **
* **Führungsqualitäten/Team-Engagement:** Du inspirierst, führst und entwickelst einen starken Teamgeist und förderst gleichzeitig die Leistung. Du hast die Fähigkeit, klare Ziele zu setzen und deinem Team Prioritäten zu vermitteln, während du gleichzeitig die Fristen einhältst.

Du gibst konstruktives Feedback und führst deine Teams, indem du ein Vorbild bist. Du bist empathisch und kannst gut Beziehungen aufbauen. Du förderst ein Klima des Vertrauens, das es dir ermöglicht, aus der Vielfalt der einzelnen Teammitglieder zu schöpfen.

Du hilfst deinen Teammitgliedern, sich weiterzuentwickeln, um das Beste aus sich herauszuholen.
* **Datengestützte Entscheidungsfindung:** Du kannst kritische Fragen stellen und traust dich, die Initiative zu ergreifen. Du kannst deine Komfortzone verlassen, um wichtige Leistungsindikatoren zu analysieren, deine Verkäufe zu optimieren, Vorschläge zu machen und strategische operative Entscheidungen zu treffen.
* **Management von Verkaufstools:** zur Nutzung der Systeme in den Geschäften und der digitalen Tools für einen effizienten Betrieb.
* **Antizipation von Verbraucherbedürfnissen:** für das Verständnis und die proaktive Erfüllung von Kundenerwartungen und einen garantiert erstklassigen Service.
* **Ausbildung und Erfahrung:** abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung im Kosmetik-Bereich, vorzugsweise im Einzelhandel. Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Teamführung (mind. 2 Mitarbeitende).
* **Du kennst dich aus** in der digitalen Welt und hast Interesse an allen neuen digitalen Medien.

Wenn du eine Leidenschaft für Schönheit hast und davon träumst, L-Oréal Ambassador zu werden, und wenn du der Meinung bist, dass das Profil zu dir passt, dann bewirb dich gerne bei uns!

** **

* **Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung:** Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung: Investiere in deine persönliche Entwicklung durch Weiterbildungen u.a. in den Bereichen Parfümerie, Schönheitstechnologien, Verkaufstechniken für Luxusgüter, um dein Fachwissen zu vertiefen und deinen nächsten Karriereschritt zu gehen.
* **Karriereentwicklung :** L-Oréal Luxe bietet klare Karrieremöglichkeiten und Aufstiegschancen. Du kannst zum Make Up Expert, Skin Care Coach, Brand Sell Out Coach oder Regional Manager aufsteigen.
* **Inklusives Arbeitsumfeld:** Inklusives Umfeld: Verwirkliche dich in einem dynamischen und unterstützenden Umfeld, in dem Vielfalt, Individualität und Leidenschaft geschätzt werden. Wir bei L-Oréal finden, dass die Vielfalt der Teams Innovation und Kreativität fördert.
* **Positive Auswirkungen:** fördern verantwortungsvolle Marken. Einige Marken von L-Oréal Luxe unterstützen wichtige gesellschaftliche und ökologische Projekte, so kannst du einen positiven Einfluss nehmen.

s.h: **WERDE TEIL DES TEAMS VON L-ORÉAL LUXE **
s.t:
Du begeisterst dich für die Welt der Schönheit? Du bringst gerne die Schönheit von anderen zum Ausdruck?
Dann würden wir gerne von dir hören! Werde Ambassador für das renommierte Markenportfolio von L'Oréal Luxe, den führenden Marken im Schönheitsmarkt. Kosmetik, Pflege und Parfüms mit Lancôme, Yves Saint Laurent, Giorgio Armani und unseren Luxus-Designerparfüms.
Wir bieten spannende Karrieremöglichkeiten: Erweitere deine Fähigkeiten und deine Leidenschaft in einem luxuriösen Umfeld und entdecke verschiedene Werdegänge bei L-Oréal. Im Rahmen dieser Möglichkeiten kannst du verschiedene Rollen übernehmen, z. B. Make up Expert, Skin Care Coach, Store Manager, Brand Sell Out Coach und viele mehr. Erhalte Zugang zu exklusiven Giorgio Armani Beauty-Schulungsprogrammen und zu den zahlreichen Lernmöglichkeiten von L-Oréal.

L-Oréal ist auf 150 Märkten und fünf Kontinenten vertreten und widmet sich seit über einem Jahrhundert der Aufgabe, «Schönheit zu kreieren, die die Welt inspiriert und bewegt». Mit einem Gesamtumsatz von 42 Milliarden Euro ist der Konzern heute weltweit führend in der Kosmetikbranche. Gemeinsam meistern wir umfassende, komplexe Herausforderungen und wollen die Welt dabei inklusiver und nachhaltiger machen - für alle Menschen und für unseren Planeten.
L-Oréal Luxe, der weltweit führende Anbieter von luxuriöser Schönheitspflege und hochwertigen Parfüms, beschäftigt weltweit mehr als 35.000 Schönheitsexpert\*innen. Unsere Mission ist die Kreation der besten Luxus-Schönheitsprodukte und -erlebnisse in den Bereichen Parfümerie, Hautpflege und Make-up. Mit seinem Portfolio aus 25 hochwertigen und sich ergänzenden Marken bringt L-Oréal Luxe seine einzigartige Vision von luxuriöser Schönheit zum Ausdruck: La Culture de l-Écart.

Continuous Improvement & Special Assignments

* Smart, curious, and eager to learn.
* Proactive and solutions-oriented.
* Comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy.
* Able to connect the dots and anticipate needs.
* Confident interacting with senior stakeholders.

Altenrhein Aviation / Egli Paint (Aviation Plaza Altenrhein)
Un concept mis à l-épreuve
Aviation Plaza Altenrhein repose sur une promesse simple : trois spécialistes indépendants - Altenrhein Aviation pour la maintenance, AeroVisto pour la cabine, Egli Paint pour l-extérieur - travaillant dans un même aéroport, selon un même calendrier, durant un seul temps d-immobilisation. Pas une fusion ; un partenariat rodé à l-aéroport de St. Gallen-Altenrhein.
Le client qui a mis cette promesse à l-épreuve connaissait bien le lieu. Son Phenom 300 venait chez Altenrhein Aviation pour sa maintenance programmée année après année - une relation que le propriétaire décrit simplement : « Nous sommes comme une famille. » Lors de ces visites, AeroVisto intervenait régulièrement sur la cabine - accoudoirs, parties en bois, sièges - et son équipe visitait les ateliers pendant que d-autres rénovations prenaient forme.
Puis est venue l-inspection des 120 mois, l-événement le plus complet du calendrier de maintenance de l-avion. Le propriétaire a contacté Natascha Rode, directrice générale de AAL AG & Egli Paint GmbH, avec une décision qui a transformé un événement de maintenance en quelque chose de plus grand : profiter de l-immobilisation pour une rénovation complète - maintenance, cabine et extérieur, le tout en même temps.
Il est difficile de concevoir un projet plus dense sur un jet léger. Chaque métier réuni par l-Aviation Plaza, sur un même avion, selon un même calendrier - c-est précisément la complexité pour laquelle le concept a été conçu.
La partie maintenance
Chez Altenrhein Aviation, l-inspection des 120 mois a pénétré profondément dans la cellule, jusqu-à la révision du train d-atterrissage - selon les mots du propriétaire : « Ils doivent tout démonter. C-est vraiment quelque chose de majeur. » La préparation était à la hauteur.

L-inspection avait été planifiée avec le client environ un an à l-avance, et tout au long de la maintenance, une réunion hebdomadaire réunissait Altenrhein Aviation, l-équipe du client et Embraer autour d-une même table - les problèmes discutés tôt, les décisions prises rapidement.
« Ce n-est pas un travail facile - c-est un projet très, très difficile », déclare le propriétaire à propos de l-étendue de la maintenance. Sa conclusion : « Je suis très satisfait de ce qu-ils ont fait. »
La partie intérieure
Pour AeroVisto, le projet a commencé là où toute rénovation devrait débuter : par une inspection d-entrée documentée. Cela a changé le plan.

Le placage en bois, en service depuis plus d-une décennie, avait dépassé le stade où un simple revernissage était une option - ainsi, la menuiserie de la cabine a été replaquée puis montée jusqu-à une finition brillante brun foncé profonde qui reflète désormais la cabine autour.

Les parties plaquées racontaient une histoire similaire et ont été replaquées intégralement.
La nouvelle cabine paraît lumineuse, calme et précise. Six sièges 16G sont recouverts de cuir beige clair, avec une couture en losange qui donne à la cabine son détail signature ; le divan suit en cuir assorti.

Au plafond et le long des fenêtres, la garniture de plafond, les habillages de fenêtres et les lambrequins sont en ultracuir doux et clair qui laisse la lumière du jour faire son travail. Au sol, une moquette tuftée à la machine de ton tabac ancre la palette ; les monuments sombres et brillants l-encadrent.

Même les transitions sont soignées - nouvelles ceintures de sécurité en beige assorti, y compris les ceintures à airbag, les compartiments à bagages doublés, les escaliers d-embarquement finis avec un nouveau revêtement non textile, et le cockpit délibérément conservé dans son caractère existant avec un nouveau cuir gris moyen et une peau de mouton gris argenté.
Les décisions de design ont été prises sur place - lors des visites du client à Altenrhein, accueillies comme l-Aviation Plaza sait le faire : matériaux sur la table, ateliers à quelques pas, et Natascha Rode veillant à ce que chaque visite se déroule aussi bien que le projet lui-même.

Que le design final soit encore affiné alors que la production était déjà en cours n-a jamais posé problème - à un même endroit, les approbations, échantillons et travaux avançaient de concert.

Derrière tout cela, la voie de la certification : tests de combustion, données d-ingénierie approuvées, ordre d-ingénierie et formulaire 1 - la paperasse nécessaire avant qu-une cabine puisse être belle.
La partie peinture
Dans l-atelier de peinture moderne d-Egli Paint sur le site de l-Aviation Plaza, l-avion a reçu une finition extérieure complète - masqué, poncé et refini avec un brillant profond et uniforme. Et pendant que l-extérieur prenait forme, les travaux de maintenance et de cabine continuaient en parallèle, à quelques pas sur le même site.
Ce que change un même lieu
Un projet avec autant de métiers a un ennemi naturel : la distance. Le propriétaire, qui gère des projets aéronautiques depuis des années, le formule précisément : « Il faut finir A avant de passer à B. Si quelque chose doit être expédié de loin, cela peut retarder d-autres travaux. Quand la plupart des entreprises de soutien pour un projet comme celui-ci sont juste au coin de la rue, cela aide beaucoup. »
À Altenrhein, « au coin de la rue » est à prendre au sens littéral. Lors d-une visite, le propriétaire est passé chez AeroVisto et Egli Paint - à côté, selon ses mots. Les constats étaient discutés à l-avion, pas par chaînes d-e-mails. Et à travers tout cela, un niveau de soin personnel que le propriétaire résume en une phrase à propos de Natascha Rode : « Si vous appelez Natascha la nuit, elle est là pour vous. »
AeroVisto sert des clients dans le monde entier, et la distance n-a jamais été un obstacle : des solutions logistiques dédiées - démontage, emballage et transport gérés par les équipes d-AeroVisto - maintiennent même les projets complexes simples, où que soit basé l-avion. Et pourtant, l-Aviation Plaza ajoute quelque chose de spécial : chaque spécialiste, chaque décision, et le client lui-même - en un seul lieu.
La confirmation
Le projet s-est clôturé en personne : un contrôle qualité client sur place, puis le remontage final et la redélivrance - maintenance achevée, extérieur refini, cabine renouvelée du cockpit au compartiment à bagages. Un avion que le propriétaire appelle désormais, selon ses propres mots, « élégant et beau. »
Son verdict sur l-ensemble : « Après 120 mois, c-est plus ou moins comme si nous recevions un avion tout neuf. »
Et debout dans la cabine, il est allé plus loin dans le passé. Il avait déjà récupéré cet avion une fois - au Brésil, en 2015, à la livraison : « Regardez ce beau matériau. C-était exactement pareil quand je suis allé au Brésil pour recevoir cet avion - exactement comme ça. Tout neuf. »
Un propriétaire qui compare un avion à sa onzième année au jour où il l-a reçu - c-est le résultat que trois spécialistes se sont engagés à livrer, et la confirmation que le concept Aviation Plaza tient ses promesses.

This VA will work claims, call insurance companies directly, and keep the billing cycle moving without things backing up.
Beyond billing, this role owns compliance tracking that's currently slipping: keeping plans of care, prescriptions, and referrals current so nothing expires unnoticed, and pulling business metrics out of the EMR into the practice's reporting system on a consistent weekly and monthly basis. This is a proactive, detail-first role, not one where someone waits to be told what to do. The right person builds the daily list of what needs attention before being asked.
About the Client

Their core values center on treating every child with the compassion of family, integrating joy and play into learning, staying curious to understand each child's unique strengths, and holding to ethical, evidence-based care.
The practice is growing, both in patient volume and provider headcount, and is working to build out more consistent systems and processes to support that growth without burning out its admin team.

Work claims and follow up on unpaid or denied claims
Call insurance companies directly to resolve billing issues

Resolve billing discrepancies and ensure compliance with coding and billing regulations
Generate billing reports for management

Help therapists stay on top of re-evaluations
Follow up to ensure referrals return after being sent out
Reporting & Data Support

Enter clinician statistics and business metrics into the practice's reporting/KPI system on a weekly and monthly basis
Support point-of-care system tasks that therapists don't have time to manage themselves

APPLICANTS MUST MEET ALL OF THE FOLLOWING MINIMUM QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS FOR THE POSITION. To meet the minimum qualification requirements for this position, you must show that you possess the Executive Core Qualifications (ECQ) and Technical Qualifications (TQ) related to this position within your resume - NOT TO EXCEED 2 PAGES.

Resumes over the 2-page limit, will not be reviewed beyond page 2 or may be disqualified. Your resume should include examples of experience, education, and accomplishments applicable to the qualification(s). If your resume does not reflect demonstrated evidence of these qualifications, you may not receive consideration for the position.

TECHNICAL QUALIFICATIONS (TQs): Your resume must clearly demonstrate that you possess the following technical qualifications.

TQ 1: Demonstrates executive experience in providing leadership and direction to a complex scientific or technical organization, such as the management or oversight of nationally recognized large-scale research and development facilities or programs.

TQ 2: Demonstrates a general understanding of science and technology, as well as a working knowledge of and ability to oversee a wide variety of business and operational management systems.

EXECUTIVE CORE QUALIFICATIONS (ECQs): In addition to the Technical Qualification Requirements listed above, all new entrants into the Senior Executive Service (SES) under a career appointment will be assessed for executive competency against the following five mandatory ECQs.

If your 2-page resume does not reflect demonstrated evidence of the ECQs and TQs, you may not receive further consideration for the position.

There are five ECQs: ECQ 1: Commitment to the Rule of Law and the Principles of the American Founding - This core qualification requires a demonstrated knowledge of the American system of government, commitment to uphold the Constitution and the rule of law, and commitment to serve the American people.

ECQ 2: Driving Efficiency - This core qualification involves the demonstrated ability to strategically and efficiently manage resources, budget effectively, cut wasteful spending, and pursue efficiency through process and technological upgrades.

ECQ 3: Merit and Competence - This core qualification involves the demonstrated knowledge, ability and technical competence to effectively and reliably produce work that is of exceptional quality.

ECQ 4: Leading People - This core qualification involves the demonstrated ability to lead and inspire a group toward meeting the organization's vision, mission, and goals, and to drive a high-performance, high-accountability culture. This includes, when necessary, the ability to lead people through change and to hold individuals accountable.

ECQ 5: Achieving Results - This core qualification involves the demonstrated ability to achieve both individual and organizational results, and to align results to stated goals from superiors.

Note: If you are a member of the SES or have been certified through successful participation in an OPM approved SES Candidate Development Program (SESCDP), or have SES reinstatement eligibility, you do not need to respond to the ECQs.

Instead, you should attach proof (e.g., SF-50, Certification by OPM's SES Qualifications Review Board (QRB)) of your eligibility for noncompetitive appointment to the SES.

## Description ##
## Where passion meets opportunity ##

## Your Purpose ##
This is an exciting opportunity for the right professional to contribute to the start-up and development of the newly established MSC Site Office in Papenburg. The Office Manager is responsible for overseeing all activities related to office operations, facilities management, employee onboarding, and administrative support for personnel within the MYM Papenburg division, as well as its external collaborators. This is a permanent employment.

**Site Office Administration**
* Ensures office compliance with Health and Safety regulations and company policies.
* Manages the calendar of pick up and transfer from airports for MYM employees and Office Employees.
* Organises business travel according to the instructions of the Site Director.
* Manages the access into the construction site of visitors as per MEYER and MSC requirement and ensure that prevention plans are updated and in line with local regulations.
* Provides administrative support and relations with various hotels and accommodation facilities to support the stay of MSC staff based at Site Office during their time in Papenburg and the latest construction phase.
* Requests drawings, manuals, technical documentation, and other relevant information from yard, as required by the Ship Construction Manager
* Supports the Ship-s construction Manager in filing and archiving inspections and drawings into the Office database related to the Ships under construction in Papenburg.
* Manages the set-up of the meeting rooms, kitchenette and store (clothing, PPE, etc for visitors only).
* Manages the set-up of the meeting rooms on board prior sea trials (attendance on board could be needed but not deemed).
* Manages the stationery also with direct and / or scheduled purchases prior approved by Site Director.
* Ensures that maintenance at the Site Office is done by requesting assistance to the appointed provider.
* Ensures that cleaning and garbage collecting at the Site Office is done by the appointed provider.
* Provides Administrative support and relation with our Agent for the follow up documentation related to MYM employees and seafarers based at Site Office during the latest construction phase.
**HR & Accounting Management **
* Assists with office and HR projects related to the set up and development of the organisation.
* Process starters and leavers on the Company HR system (Success Factors and Opnet) and the payroll systems.
* Assists with employee onboarding, induction and coordinates their probation process.
* Supports MYM Employees during the search of apartments and car lease in the area by dealing directly with local agencies.
* Follows the employee lifecycle becoming their first point of contact for HR and administrative related matters (i.e. ensuring presence and absence is appropriately logged on the systems, obtaining medical certificates for sickness, drafting letters and documents for employees, responding to general queries in relation to HR or payroll/benefits matters, etc).
* Follows the administration of the company Individual Performance Management process.
* Manages the occupational medicine appointments for MYM employees.
* Supports with payroll and tax office (i.e. helps the Site Director preparing the file with the entries for payroll and to check the monthly payroll).
* Supports Site Director in managing employee relations.
* Helps with writing new company policies and reviewing current practices.
* Prepares management and ad-hoc reports for HR or the Local/Group Finance team.
* Files and archives travel expenses forms for MYM employees.
* Provides support for the accounting documents and invoices related to the activities and costs incurred by the Site Office for the Construction phase of the vessel built as MEYER WERFT.
## Your Journey so far ##
* Teamwork, excellent organizational and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication, relational and organizational skills.
* Good ability to work independently.
* Availability to work longer hours during the preparation of sea trials and during the last weeks before ship-s delivery.
## Your Essentials ##
* Several years of qualified HR experience.
* Fluency in German and English, knowledge of Italian is a plus.
* Excellent knowledge of the MS Office package.
* Existing right to live and work in the EU.

La Chancellerie d’Etat CHA offre un environnement de travail stimulant au cœur des activités du Gouvernement cantonal et transverse à l’administration cantonale.

Nous misons sur la complémentarité des compétences et la variété des perspectives car c’est la diversité des parcours et des profils qui fait la force de l’Etat de Fribourg. Nous favorisons la conciliation vie professionnelle et vie privée et les conditions de travail flexibles. Pour en savoir plus, suivez ce lien.

## À propos du Département des Affaires étrangères et du Commerce ##
Le rôle du Département des Affaires étrangères et du Commerce (DFAT) est de promouvoir les intérêts de l'Australie et des Australiens à l'international.

Cela implique de renforcer la sécurité de l'Australie, d'améliorer sa prospérité, de fournir un programme d'aide étrangère efficace et de haute qualité, et d'aider les voyageurs australiens ainsi que les Australiens à l'étranger. Le département fournit des conseils en politique étrangère, commerciale et de développement au gouvernement australien.

Le DFAT collabore également avec d'autres agences gouvernementales australiennes pour coordonner la poursuite des intérêts globaux, régionaux et bilatéraux de l'Australie.
## À propos du poste ##
Sous la direction, l'Assistant Exécutif de l'Ambassadeur et du Vice-Ambassadeur fournit un soutien exécutif, administratif et organisationnel de haut niveau à la Mission Permanente d'Australie auprès des Nations Unies à Genève. Le poste organise également des événements et fonctions officiels.
En raison de la nature sensible du travail, ce poste nécessite de pouvoir obtenir et maintenir une habilitation de sécurité nationale reconnue par le DFAT.
## Les principales responsabilités du poste incluent, sans s'y limiter : ##
* Fournir un soutien exécutif de haut niveau à l'Ambassadeur et au Vice-Ambassadeur, assurant le bon fonctionnement des bureaux exécutifs dans un environnement rapide et sensible.
* Gérer et prioriser la correspondance, les invitations, les documents d'information et les demandes, en faisant preuve d'un jugement avisé pour déterminer les priorités, les actions et les exigences de conformité.
* Coordonner les visites officielles et les programmes de délégation pour les ministres, hauts fonctionnaires et visiteurs de haut niveau, en équilibrant les priorités concurrentes et les exigences opérationnelles.
* Planifier et organiser des événements de représentation, des réunions et des engagements officiels, en liaison avec les parties prenantes internes et externes pour atteindre les objectifs de la Mission.
* Gérer les dépenses de représentation et l'administration financière, y compris les prévisions, les justifications, les rapprochements et les rapports conformément aux politiques et procédures du DFAT.
* Coordonner les déplacements, la logistique et les arrangements administratifs liés aux activités de la direction exécutive et officielles, en assurant la conformité aux politiques et procédures pertinentes.
* Surveiller les risques liés à la sécurité, aux opérations et au flux de travail, en mettant en œuvre les contrôles nécessaires et en escaladant les problèmes le cas échéant.
* Fournir des conseils administratifs, maintenir des systèmes d'affaires efficaces et soutenir la coordination de l'équipe, contribuant à l'amélioration continue et à l'efficacité organisationnelle.
## Qualifications/Expérience/Connaissances/Compétences requises ##
* Expérience avérée dans un rôle similaire d'Assistant Exécutif
* Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale
* Capacité à travailler en équipe et à soutenir celle-ci. Capacité à développer et maintenir des relations respectueuses et efficaces avec les parties prenantes internes et externes
* Capacité à gérer le temps, à prioriser, planifier, gérer plusieurs tâches et travailler efficacement sous pression
* Compétences en gestion financière et organisationnelle
* Discrétion et jugement avisé dans la gestion d'informations confidentielles
* Expérience étendue de l'utilisation de Microsoft Office et des applications électroniques
* Compétences exceptionnelles en service client et en relations interpersonnelles
* Maîtrise de l'anglais requise, la maîtrise du français étant fortement appréciée
* Connaissance ou capacité à acquérir rapidement une connaissance de la législation du gouvernement australien ou des politiques et directives départementales relatives aux fonctions du poste
## Souhaitable ##
* Expérience préalable dans une ambassade, une organisation internationale ou un environnement comparable.
## Exigences de sécurité ##
* Habilitation de sécurité NV2 australienne ou capacité à l'obtenir et la maintenir. Les candidats doivent donc être citoyens australiens pour être considérés.
* Veuillez noter que les candidats détenant la citoyenneté ou la double citoyenneté suisse ne sont pas éligibles à une habilitation de sécurité australienne.

## **Votre rôle** ##
En tant que **Coordinateur·trice de programme**, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans la planification, l'organisation et la coordination des programmes et événements de la Fondation.

Vous assurerez le suivi des différentes étapes des projets, de leur préparation à leur évaluation, en collaboration avec les équipes internes, les bénévoles, les intervenants et les partenaires.

Vous veillerez à la bonne coordination des aspects logistiques, administratifs et organisationnels, tout en garantissant une communication fluide entre les différentes parties prenantes. ### Missions et responsabilités ###
**Planification et coordination des événements :**
* Participer à l-élaboration et à la mise en œuvre de la planification, des calendriers et des budgets des événements.

**Communications, marketing et promotion :**
* Centraliser et fournir les informations sur le programme et les intervenants à l'équipe de communication pour la publication numérique et les présentations.
* Coordonner avec l'équipe de communication pour gérer la stratégie de promotion de l'événement, y compris les invitations, la planification sur les réseaux sociaux et les besoins en supports promotionnels.
* Suivre la participation en coordonnant les inscriptions et en surveillant les confirmations de présence avec les équipes de l'hospitalité et de la communication.
* S'assurer que tous les supports de l'événement (signalétique, programmes, badges et articles promotionnels) sont préparés en collaboration avec les équipes de l'hospitalité et de la communication.

* Coordonner la facturation et la consolidation.

* Maîtrise courante de l'anglais et du français, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, avec d'excellentes capacités rédactionnelles.
* Compétences exceptionnelles en coordination d'équipe, en gestion de projet et en relations interpersonnelles.

* Travail dans un cadre unique et inspirant

Le groupe CCHE est en évolution permanente et il regroupe désormais 6 filiales ancrées localement, proposant leur expertise dans toute la chaîne de production architecturale, renforcées par 3 sociétés apportant des prestations complémentaires dans les domaines du digital, de la construction ou de l’expertise immobilière.

Les synergies et la complémentarité entre les sites permettent le déploiement de projets à toutes les échelles (architecture du paysage, urbanisme, architecture, architecture d'intérieur, design et réalisation) en s’appuyant sur des outils et méthodologies innovants.

Cette envie de se dépasser se concrétise également par un engagement dans différentes collaborations internationales pour la réalisation de projets ambitieux.

Die Finanzkontrolle der Stadt erfüllt ihren Auftrag als unabhängiges, politisch neutrales Fachorgan der Finanzaufsicht. Die Finanzkontrolle unterstützt den Stadtrat, die Direktionen, die Verwaltung und die Geschäftsprüfungskommission des Stadtparlaments in Fragen der Aufsicht, der Rechnungslegung und der internen Kontrolle.
